an10.66:1.1: LXVI. Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Sāriputto Magadhesu viharati Nālakagāmake. Atha kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca
an10.66:2.1: ‘kin nu kho āvuso Sāriputta imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sukhaṃ kiṃ dukkhan' ti? Anabhirati kho āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dukkhā, akhirati sukhā. Anabhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: gacchanto pi sukhaṃ sātaṃ nādhigacchati, ṭhito pi . . . nisinno pi . . . sayāno pi . . . gāmagato pi . . . araññagato pi . . . rukkhamūlagato pi . . . suññāgāragato pi . . . abbhokāsagato pi . . . bhikkhumajjhagato pi sukhaṃ sātaṃ nādhigacchati. Anabhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ dukkhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
an10.66:3.1: Abhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: gacchanto pi sukhaṃ sātaṃ adhigacchati, ṭhito pi . . . nisinno pi . . . sayāno pi . . . gāmagato pi . . . araññagato pi . . . rukkhamūlagato pi . . . suññāgāragato pi . . . abbhokāsagato pi . . . bhikkhumajjhagato pi sukhaṃ sātaṃ adhigacchati. Abhiratiyā āvuso sati idaṃ sukhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhan ti.
